svg.title: MengAI architecture
svg.desc: Two kinds of input, an app goal for the studio crew and a trading thesis for the hedge fund crew, go into one crew engine on the owner's Mac. The engine sits behind a guard and holds the brain, memory, hands, trading desk and local storage. It returns a working app with a live preview, or orders and a P&L report, and it calls the model providers, the JEV judge and the exchanges the owner picks.
svg.text: Live beta at mengai.adefebrian.com. One crew engine, two kinds of work, all on the owner’s Mac.
a goal for the studio crew
a thesis for the fund crew
